title: Senior hurlers into the championship quarter-final
summary: A four point win over Springfield Harps sends the senior hurlers through. The quarter-final is at home on the 12th and the club expects a big crowd.

title: Registration for the 2027 season opens on 1 October
summary: Membership rates are held at 2026 levels. The family cap covers any number of children in the one household.

title: New reserved viewing spaces at Sean Walsh Park
summary: Two wheelchair spaces are now marked and kept free on the stand side, with a level path from the car park.
